title: Gideon and the Harvest
author: Ansel Zhou
blurb: Oscar Marchetti, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
